node.statement: The displayed maximum formula gives W.K_call>=1,W.K1,W.K2,W.K3. Multiplication by epsilon>=0 therefore gives epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon and W.Ki*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon for i=1,2,3; the atomic scalar scale equals W.K_call*epsilon. Thus the global, atomic, and three stage scales are all at most W.K_call*epsilon.
